content:
- name: Export complete original int64 Tensor native evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: integer-tensor-native-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: |
            build/integer-tensors-ci-raw.tar.xz
            build/integer-tensors-ci-raw-manifest.json
            build/hosted-integer-tensors-native.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 9
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Index original int64-profile full640 journals and oracle reports
        if: always()
        env:
          HEPTATORCH_SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          HEPTATORCH_OBSERVER_ARTIFACT: integer-node-journals-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
        run: |
          python3 -I -S -B tests/private_node_accounting/collect_private_node_journals.py \
            --build build --journal-root build/frozen35-integer-node --wire-root build/frozen35-integer-node-wire \
            --reports build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35.json build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-original.json \
              build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-observer-controls.json build/integer-tensors-storage-tombstone.json \
              build/pytorch-integer-tensors-backward.json build/pytorch-install.json \
            --job-status '${{ job.status }}'

      - name: Export original int64-profile full640 journals and wire traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: integer-node-journals-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: |
            build/frozen35-integer-node/
            build/frozen35-integer-node-wire/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 9
          retention-days: 30
